title: Tokyo Marathon 2026 — GO TOKYO official tourism page
claims: The nearest station to the start area is Tochomae Station, Exit A4, about one minute on foot on the Toei Oedo Line.
The course runs from the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building to Gyoko-dori Avenue in front of Tokyo Station.
The 2026 race was held on 1 March 2026 and welcomed 39,000 runners across the full marathon and 10.7 km race.
Road closures and traffic restrictions apply on race day.
The page was updated on 2 March 2026 and states that the 2026 edition has already taken place.
